description: Trigger evaluation dataset for cloud-config skill. 6 queries: 3 should trigger, 3 should NOT trigger.

queries.query: Configura Azure Key Vault con Managed Identity para gestionar los secretos de producción
queries.note: Caso principal: configurar Key Vault + Managed Identity

queries.query: Set up Azure Blob Storage for file uploads with SAS tokens and the BlobServiceClient
queries.note: English trigger: Azure Blob Storage configuration

queries.query: Integra Redis como caché distribuida y configura Application Insights para telemetría
Busca secretos hardcodeados y vulnerabilidades de seguridad en el código
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar security-audit. Buscar secretos != configurar Azure

queries.query: Configura OpenTelemetry y Serilog para logging estructurado
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar observability-patterns. OpenTelemetry != Azure config

queries.query: Connect to the Oracle HCM external API using HttpClientFactory with OAuth2
queries.note: NEGATIVE: Debe activar api-integration-patterns. Integrar API externa != configurar Azure

overlap_notes.security-audit: Key Vault: cloud-config CONFIGURA Key Vault, security-audit DETECTA secretos expuestos
overlap_notes.observability-patterns: App Insights: cloud-config configura el SERVICIO Azure, observability-patterns configura la INSTRUMENTACIÓN OpenTelemetry
